name: February 3, 2022 Youth Government Summit
agenda_text:
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to
submit written questions in advance of the meeting so they can be appropriately addressed during the
presentation. Questions may be emailed to kgallo@malibucity.org.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING AND PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members
of the public may ask questions or add public comment at the end of the presentation through the
Zoom application (Zoom Meeting ID: 829 0462 2628 and Passcode: 251103) using the raise hand
feature. Each speaker will be limited to three (3) minutes.

  Harry Barovsky Memorial
  Youth Commission
  Special Meeting

  Thursday, February 3, 2022
  6:00 P.M. – 6:45 P.M
  Various Teleconferenced Locations

  Zoom Meeting ID: 829-0462-2628
  Password: 251103

Six p.m.  Special Meeting

Government Summit
The Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission will hold a government summit to listen to guest
speakers Jeremy Wolf, Kasey Earnest, and Austin Toyama provide answers to questions the
Commission preselected at its December 2, 2021, Regular meeting. The community is invited to
listen to the speakers via the Zoom link listed above. Commissioners may be present to listen to the
presentation but will not discuss any business or take any action during this meeting.

Adjournment

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing
agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements. Special meeting agendas
may be amended up to 24 hours in advance of the meeting. Dated this 31st day of January, at 4:00
p.m.

  ____________________________
  Kate Gallo, Recreation Manager
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  HARRY BAROVSKY MEMORIAL YOUTH COMMISSION
  SPECIAL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 3, 2022
  TELECONFERENCED – VARIOUS LOCATIONS
  6:00 P.M.

The following meeting was held pursuant to AB 361 and fully teleconferenced from various
locations during the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Nicole Reynaga called the meeting to order at 6:04 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance via teleconference by the Recording
  Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Nicole Reynaga, Vice Chair Jacqueline Reynaga, Commissioners Jaz
  Abbey, Eden Amar, Addison Arlidge, Aspen Aragon, Austin Aragon, Allegra Barzan,
  Garrett Button, India Cortese, Kylie Epstein, Logan Epstein, Colten Fisher, Maya Guzman,
  Chloe Loquet, Matthew Maischoss, Takoda Moore, Maxine Kelly, Axel Polito, Layla
  Polito, and Luke Webster

  ABSENT: Commissioners Tyler Button, Michael Maischoss, Cooper Norby, and Hank
  Norby

  ALSO PRESENT: Kate Gallo, Recreation Manager; Loren Davis, Recreation Coordinator;
  Amanda Rigali, Recreation Coordinator; and Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative
  Assistant

ITEM 1  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  Youth Government Summit with speakers Jeremy Wolf, District Director for
  California State Senator Henry Stern, Austin Toyama, Environmental
  Sustainability Cooordinator for the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District,
  and Kasey Earnest, Executive Direct for the Boys and Girls Club of Malibu.

  February 3, 2022 Youth Government Summit Questions:
  • How did you get your job, and what do you enjoy the most about it?
  • What are your day-to-day responsibilities?
  • Why did you enter your career field?
  • What steps did you take to get into your field?
  • What advice would you give to students who want to be involved in
  advocacy?
  • What types of programs or campaigns have you implemented that have
  sparked youth involvement?
